description: This Java class manages LwM2M sessions within the Thingsboard platform, handling registration and deregistration of sessions, and interacting with related services and message listeners.

classes.name: DefaultLwM2MSessionManager
classes.description: Manages LwM2M sessions, handling registration and deregistration, and coordinating message listeners and session events.

methods.name: DefaultLwM2MSessionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing session manager with required services and handlers.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new LwM2M session, setting up message listener and notifying the transport service.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters an existing LwM2M session and updates the transport service.
